newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tonen, Taiyo to boost capacity of secondary units.
newsitem.headline: Tonen, Taiyo to boost capacity of secondary units.

text.p: Refiner Tonen Corp will raise the capacity of its Kawasaki plant's fluid catalytic cracker by 3,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 84,000 bpd in June, the trade ministry said on Monday.

The Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) also said Taiyo Oil Co Ltd will expand its vacuum distillation capacity by 2,000 bpd to 27,000 bpd at its Kikuma plant on Shikoku island, in September.

MITI said late last month that Tonen would raise the crude processing capacity of its Kawasaki plant by 15,000 bpd to 255,000 bpd, and that Taiyo plans to raise the topping capacity at the Kikuma plant by 10,000 bpd to 99,000 bpd in September.
